title: Trace the paths

steps.title: Find one guide path
steps.body: Start with a short section and follow the printed route. Separate paths remain separate.

steps.title: Trace along the guide
steps.body: Use the trial marker to follow the path. The finished reference shows the intended line, not a filled region.

steps.title: Keep the open spaces
steps.body: Do not fill between paths or connect their ends unless the printed guide already connects them.

steps.title: Compare and record
steps.body: Compare the traced section with the digital reference. Record control, line width and where the guide remains visible.
